title: Task Error
description: The error schema of a task response: a failed task carries at least one entry in `errors[]`, the task-level error list the protocol envelope defines (core/protocol-envelope.json#/definitions/TaskErrors). The envelope's `adcp_error`, which a fatal task failure SHOULD also populate, carries the same failure for clients that dispatch without reading the payload. The schema build composes this schema into the failed branch of a task's generated response. A task's own failed body exists only to add what is specific to its errors (kinds of error as branches, or fields a failure carries); it composes this schema and does not declare `errors` again. In 3.x this applies to experimental task responses and to the failed bodies of stable tasks that already required the same `errors`; 4.0 applies it to every task (DR-0038).
